info.TRANSIENT: cosmic ray or bloom onset on the ramp
info.OVERFLOW: reached about half full well (bright star); cores that overflowed early are blank
info.DICHROIC: low throughput at the band 3/4 edge
info.PERSIST: persistence from an earlier bright exposure (mimics transients)
info.OUTLIER: isolated outlier outside known sources: could be an uncatalogued source
info.SOURCE: pixel of a known catalogue source
